required: exact capture operation authority and accepted-result hash
actor Profile or explicit GM live-play actor
existing captured Pokémon sheet and post-capture revision
original roster destination and caught-ball value
naming requirement and accepted campaign minute
rules: one accepted record matches exactly one non-excluded capture reward
the current sheets cannot predate accepted capture revisions
the Pokémon exists in exactly one current owner Trainer roster
the current caught-ball field exactly preserves the accepted value
settlement never creates or copies a captured Pokémon sheet

ownership.destination: One exact Profile authority linked to the accepted capture Trainer.
ownership.actor: A player capture remains with its accepted actor Profile; an explicit GM live-play capture may be assigned to a currently authorised Profile.
ownership.permission: The exact current owner Trainer sheet revision supplies destination permission.

assignment.overflow: A team request beyond six remains pending with a box-only assignment decision; it is never silently redirected.
assignment.boxCapacity: No finite app-owned box limit exists, so general reward capacity is unbounded while the per-Trainer team limit is validated exactly.
assignment.naming: Required naming remains a visible bounded decision. Keep and set are explicit; settlement never invents a nickname.
assignment.conservation: Every non-excluded capture has exactly one whole Profile allocation and one contributing accepted-capture write.

writePlan.aggregateRevision: Each changed Trainer roster or Pokémon nickname sheet advances exactly once.
writePlan.relatedWrites: Roster and nickname changes are explicit non-contributing zero-amount, zero-capacity reward previews beside the one whole capture write.
writePlan.beforeAfterEvidence: Private sheet plans retain stable-JSON SHA-256 before and after evidence and exact source-derived next sheets.
writePlan.staleRule: Application rechecks the complete authority hash, every current sheet hash and revision, every next-sheet hash, and every next revision.
writePlan.atomicRule: Missing choices, denied permission, overflow, provenance drift, stale authority, or malformed custody expose no applicable writes. P8-080 owns persistence.

completion.pending: Missing assignment, required naming, or team-capacity resolution remains visible and blocks application.
completion.denied: Denied ownership keeps private evidence, creates no mutation, and blocks application.
completion.excluded: An explicitly excluded capture requires no allocation or write.
completion.foreignAllocation: Allocation evidence from another provider is never replaced implicitly.
completion.terminal: Committed, applied, cancelled, or already-receipted captures cannot be replanned.

privacy.safeProjection: Later UI may show safe captured Pokémon and Trainer labels, team or box choice, team occupancy, naming-needed status, and preserved ball label only to authorised audiences.
